response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong open-source, testing, and knowledge-sharing credentials, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this role. The position demands 8 years of C++ programming and 5+ years building large-scale infrastructure/compute platforms; his C/C++ exposure is limited to roughly 7 months at National Instruments and a university thesis project. His deepest systems work (high-throughput microservices at Sociomantic) was in D, not C++, and ended in 2020, with recent years focused on TypeScript/Node product work. He also lacks explicit technical-leadership or cloud-platform ownership experience, though mentoring and workshop delivery show leadership potential. A strong engineer overall, but a poor fit for a C++-centric cloud compute platform lead.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput microservices experience at scale (Sociomantic)
Proven mentoring: workshops, courses, dojos, and community talks
Broad polyglot background plus DevOps/Kubernetes/CI-CD and open-source project ownership
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~7 months professionally)
No demonstrated cloud compute platform architecture or ownership at production scale
No formal technical leadership role or evidence of driving large ambiguous multi-team projects
